text:
ara (infra): Starting maintenance window planning: network blade swap on bastions + NIC firmware across az-east-1a/b/c. Target window: Tue 2026-04-14 01:00-03:00 UTC. Expect ~10-15% GPU capacity drop in preemptible pools during rolling reboots. We'll drain nodes gracefully and backfill where possible.

marta (platform): What's the risk to Dedicated customers? any SLA impact?

ara (infra): Dedicated pools are on reserved hardware - scheduling will avoid Dedicated racks. Impact limited to shared preemptible, lowest-priority pools only. SLO hit negligible but cost will go up if we need to spin on-demand to backfill. Prefer to avoid autoscaling unless traffic spike.

kai (sre): Pls add the drain command we'll use and the max-parallel setting. Also need a manual hold step before each AZ.

ara (infra): Runbook snippet we'll use:
```
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m node/<node-name>
# controller: set maxUnavailable=1 per rack to stagger
```
We'll run `max-parallel=2` across the region, and pause 15m between racks for health checks.

ops-coordinator: I'll post the sternotice and the console banner. Can we get a single line for the public status page update?

ara (infra): Status line: "Planned rolling maintenance: bastion network blade and NIC firmware upgrades in az-east-1. Minimal service disruption expected for low-priority workloads. Window: 2026-04-14 01:00-03:00 UTC." Add link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/bastion-blade-swap

sre-oncall-bot: Note: there's an overlapping maintenance in apac gateways (APAC1) scheduled 2026-04-14 00:30-02:00 UTC. Potential increased egress load during handover. :warning:

marta (platform): Can we shift our window by +30m to avoid overlap? That would keep risk lower for traffic spikes.

ara (infra): Prefer to keep current window to avoid business-hours in EU. I'll coordinate with APAC owners. If overlap looks risky we'll move to 03:00-05:00 UTC as fallback.

kai (sre): We'll enable autoscale-safety: min-replicas bump for critical routes during window. Also adding a preflight synthetic: login + tiny-generation every 5m.

ops-coordinator: Noted. I'll trigger pagerduty schedule changes and add an on-call buddy for rollbacks.

marta (platform): Cost question: if we need on-demand backfill, any rough estimate? (ballpark)

ara (infra): Ballpark: up to ~$1.2k/hour region-wide if we spin a small fleet to maintain capacity. Expect usually under $300/hr with current traffic.

kai (sre): One more ask: add `--pod-selector='priority!=low'` to the drain command so we don't evict low-priority pods that can tolerate downtime.

ara (infra): Good call, will include. Final action items:
- ara: finalize runbook and hold steps (by EOD)
- ops-coordinator: publish status, update PDs (by EOD)
- kai: preflight synthetic + autoscale-safety (by Wed)
- marta: confirm Dedicated customer notice wording (by EOD)

ara (infra): thumbs up :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final confirmation 12h before the window.
